_comment: Benchmark regression baselines. Values represent wall-clock seconds on a single-core reference machine (GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, Python 3.11). The bench_regression.py script fails CI when measured time exceeds baseline_seconds * CLI --threshold (default 1.5x). The per-benchmark regression_factor is informational only and does not override the CLI threshold.
